call_1.purpose: select repair-relevant production files from visible buggy context
call_1.output: one JSON object with key files, an array of at most 4 safe repository-relative production file paths

call_2.purpose: produce one unified git diff against the buggy checkout
call_2.input: same visible baseline plus call-1-selected buggy source and arm context
call_2.output: one unified diff in a diff fenced block or raw unified diff

arm_context.raw_memory: all frozen acquisition RAW_MEMORY records in frozen acquisition order
arm_context.always_on: all admitted public compiled repair rules
arm_context.verified: only admitted public compiled repair rules whose frozen literal scope router matches the visible protected context

activation.always_on: true iff the frozen capability contains at least one admitted rule
activation.verified: true iff at least one admitted rule matches the frozen visible protected context

false_activation: activated is true while the deterministic frozen scope router matches zero admitted rules to the visible protected context
misapplication: activated is true, a syntactically valid patch is produced and applies cleanly to the buggy checkout, but the protected regression test still fails
competence_failure: model output invalid, no patch produced, patch rejected by path safety, patch does not apply, or protected regression test executes and fails
repair_success: patch applies cleanly and all frozen protected regression commands pass in the qualified historical environment
infrastructure_error: provider failure, checkout/network/provisioning failure, protected-test bundle mismatch, target runner failure, or timeout before a competence verdict is available

target_environment.source: same frozen BugsInPy setup.sh, requirements.txt, run_test.sh and declared Python major.minor used for qualification
target_environment.reuse: provision dependencies once per protected case; before baseline and each arm run, git reset --hard to the pinned buggy commit, restore the frozen protected test bundle, leave only the untracked dependency environment intact, then apply that arm patch
target_environment.arm_code_isolation: no production or protected-test modifications survive between arms

stopping_rule: evaluate every frozen qualified protected case exactly once in each of the four arms, two model calls maximum per case-arm, then stop
